definitions.gloss: starvation; death from hunger; starving to death
definitions.explanation: Dying as a result of prolonged lack of food. Used both literally and occasionally figuratively to express extreme hunger.

examples.japanese: {餓死|がし}する{人|ひと}がまだいる。
examples.english: There are still people who die of starvation.

examples.japanese: {戦時中|せんじちゅう}、{多|おお}くの{兵士|へいし}が{餓死|がし}した。
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers starved to death.

examples.japanese: {干|かん}ばつによる{食糧|しょくりょう}{不足|ぶそく}で、{餓死者|がししゃ}が{出|で}ていると{報告|ほうこく}されている。
examples.english: It is reported that deaths from starvation are occurring due to food shortages caused by drought.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {餓|が} (starve, hunger) + {死|し} (death). Used as a suru verb ({餓死|がし}する). A serious and somewhat formal term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餓死|がし}する (to starve to death)
- {餓死者|がししゃ} (people who died of starvation)
- {餓死|がし}{寸前|すんぜん} (on the verge of starvation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飢|う}え: hunger, starvation — the state of being hungry or starving
- {飢餓|きが}: famine, starvation — a widespread severe shortage of food
